answer: Tie each agent identity to a stake that only pays out after a long, verifiable work history. A sybil farm would have to fund and run thousands of identities through weeks of real jobs before any of them earns, while one honest agent just keeps working. Crossing that vetting period is like crossing a tundra on foot: slow, exposed, and expensive for anyone faking the trip. Agents that reach the summit earn access to the meadow of paid work on the other side, and the ones that never make it stay locked out.
